name: orb_sector_momentum_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: ORB breakouts on stocks that are sector momentum leaders (highest relative strength within their sector over the prior 5 days) have 20% higher follow-through than ORB on lagging sector members. Momentum leaders already have institutional accumulation tailwinds, and the ORB breakout is the continuation signal. By filtering ORB signals to only trade the top-2 relative strength stocks per sector (banking, IT, pharma, auto), we concentrate on the highest-conviction setups. The inefficiency exists because standard ORB doesn't incorporate cross-sectional momentum ranking — it treats all stocks equally, diluting the edge with breakouts on lagging stocks.
universe: NIFTY 50 constituents, grouped by sector (banking, IT, pharma, auto, energy)
stock_filter: stock must be top-2 by 5-day relative return within its sector; daily avg volume > ₹150cr

conditions: is_leader == True (stock is top-2 in sector by 5-day RS)
long.confirmation: close sustains above ORB_high_15 for 2+ bars AND close > EMA_9

conditions: is_leader == True in downward momentum (bottom-2 sector rank = weakest stocks)
short.confirmation: close sustains below ORB_low_15 for 2+ bars AND close < EMA_9

exit.stop_loss: ORB_mid (midpoint of 15-min range) OR 0.4% from entry
exit.trailing_stop: after 1.0 * ORB_range_15 gain, trail at ORB_high/low
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 180 mins without 50% target
exit.signal_exit: if sector index reverses > 0.5% against trade direction, exit

filters.trend_filter: sector index trending in same direction as stock breakout over 5 days
filters.event_filter: skip stocks with earnings in next 2 days; skip if sector has major regulatory news
other_filters: recompute sector rankings daily before market open; stale rankings lose edge

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-moderate — momentum factor is well-known but the ORB intersection with sector rank is niche

weaknesses: 5-day sector momentum can be driven by a single large move on day 1, making the ranking stale by day 5; the momentum may have already reversed
Restricting to top-2 per sector across 5 sectors = max 10 candidates, further filtered by ORB breakout; signal frequency can be very low (0-1 per day)
Momentum leaders are often extended and near resistance levels, making their ORB breakouts more susceptible to profit-taking reversals
prior_art: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) cross-sectional momentum; adapted for intraday ORB entry on momentum leaders. Moskowitz & Grinblatt (1999) on industry momentum.
notes: Edge math: 0.58 * 55bps - 0.42 * 28bps = 31.9 - 11.76 = 20.14bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~11.14bps/trade * 1.5 trades = ~16.7bps daily. Sector momentum filter adds ~6bps over unfiltered ORB by concentrating on stocks with institutional flow tailwinds.
